summary.zh: 制定社媒策略、内容日历、社群维护与涨粉计划
summary.en: Set social strategy, a posting calendar and a follower growth plan

description.zh: 决定发什么、什么时候发：排内容日历、定社区互动方式、规划涨粉路径，并保持账号统一的声音。适合需要长期运营社媒账号，或在规划季度内容节奏时使用。
description.en: Decides what to post and when: builds the content calendar, sets how to handle community replies, and plans follower growth with one consistent voice. Use it for ongoing account operations or when mapping a quarter of social content.
